question: Who has been appointed as the chairman of the Ratan Tata Endowment Foundation (RTEF) in February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**N Chandrasekaran.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Tata Sons chairman **N Chandrasekaran** has been appointed as the chairman of the **Ratan Tata Endowment Foundation (RTEF).**
 
• RTEF was set up by the late **Ratan Tata** to support philanthropy and social initiatives.
 
• The foundation remains independent of Tata Trusts and is categorized as a Section 8 company.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• N Chandrasekaran was appointed as per the wishes of **Ratan Tata**, who shared a close bond with him.
 
• The foundation will receive funds after Ratan Tata’s will is certified by the Bombay High Court.
 
• Unlike Tata Trusts, Noel Tata (Chairman of Tata Trusts) will not be involved with RTEF.
 
• The objective of RTEF is to focus on future technologies, social impact projects, and research.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Ratan Tata Endowment Foundation (RTEF)__

 __
 
• Established by Ratan Tata to support philanthropy and research.
 
• Will receive funds from Tata Sons, Tata Digital, and Tata Technologies.
 
 
 
• About N Chandrasekaran__
 __
 
• Current Chairman of Tata Sons since 2017.
 
• Former CEO of Tata Consultancy Services (TCS).
 
• Has played a key role in the transformation of the Tata Group.
 
 
 
• Section 8 Companies in India__
 
 
• Non-profit entities registered under the Companies Act, 2013.
 
• Used for charitable, social, educational, and research purposes.
 
• Cannot distribute profits to shareholders.
